text:
Rhea Kapoor: :loudspeaker: Launching the on-prem HSM migration playbook for Private/VPC customers who want to move from software CMKs to HSM-backed keys. Posting high-level plan, runbooks, and action items.

Liam O'Connor: Is this targeted at customers who asked for FIPS-grade keys, or more broadly?

Rhea Kapoor: Both. Priority is customers with regulatory needs (FedRAMP, PCI, FIPS) but the playbook supports any customer that requests HSM migration.

Samir Gupta: Quick summary of options for customers: 1) assisted-migration (SRE + Security), 2) self-serve toolkit (redwood-hsm-migrate), 3) phased hybrid (split keys). Which do we recommend?

Rhea Kapoor: Assisted-migration recommended for air-gapped/HSM scenarios. Self-serve OK for cloud VPC with KMS integrations. Hybrid for staged rollouts.

Claire Boudreaux: Runbook highlights: pre-migration inventory, key policy audit, preflight checks, dry-run rewrap, cutover window, post-migration validation, rollback steps.

Jordan Lee: Customer comms: we need a short advisory + checklist link. Also include estimated timeline and cost (assisted hours + travel if on-prem). I can draft.

Samir Gupta: CLI snippet for self-serve toolkit: 

```
redwood-hsm-migrate plan --cluster CLUSTER_ID --source cmk://alias/old-key --target hsm://alias/new-key
# outputs: plan-id, estimated-downtime, steps
```

Samir Gupta: And execute: 
```
redwood-hsm-migrate run --plan PLAN_ID --dry-run
# dry-run shows rewrap operations and token-refresh windows
```

Liam O'Connor: Preflight command added to installer: 

```
redwoodctl onprem preflight-hsm --cluster CLUSTER_ID --hsm-endpoint /dev/hsm0
# expected: hsm_ready: true, policy_compat: true, network: OK
```

Claire Boudreaux: We added checks for key_policy mismatches and auth-scopes. If key_policy prevents rewrap, migration will fail fast and suggest policy edits.

Rhea Kapoor: Operational constraints: for in-flight attachments there may be a short token-refresh window (30-90s depending on client TTL). We recommend scheduling cutovers during low-traffic windows and increasing client retries.

Jordan Lee: Draft customer-facing ETA: typical assisted migration takes 1-3 business days for cloud VPC, 3-10 business days for air-gapped on-prem with HSM ops. Will include opt-out and rollback options.

Samir Gupta: Example SRE checklist excerpt: 
```
1) snapshot config & tokens
2) validate hsm connectivity & policy
3) perform dry-run rewrap on nonprod
4) schedule cutover, notify stakeholders
5) run small-batch rewrap, monitor errors
6) expand to full cluster, validate metrics
```

Liam O'Connor: Metrics to watch: rewrap_error_rate, token_refresh_failures, p95_inference_latency, auth_denials. Add dashboard tile and alert if rewrap_error_rate > 0.5% in 10m.

Ops Bot: Canary schedule created: canary-a: 2026-09-02T04:00Z (cloud-vpc), canary-b: 2026-09-04T05:00Z (onprem non-airgap). Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/hsm-migrate/canaries

Claire Boudreaux: HSM/air-gap note: we ship a signed migration bundle and an offline verification tool. Customers must perform HSM-side signing and provide a rewrap-authorization token. Appendix documents this flow.

Rhea Kapoor: Legal/Sales note: assisted migrations for enterprise customers are billable. CS will have SKU codes and a standard SOW template. Jordan -> coordinate with Sales.

Jordan Lee: Will add SKU codes + brief pricing tiers (assisted small/medium/enterprise). Draft SOW link: https://docs.internal.redwood/cs/sow/hsm-migrate-draft

Samir Gupta: Rollback plan example: rewrap previous key, re-issue tokens, and optionally roll back any index keys. `redwood-hsm-migrate rollback --plan PLAN_ID` will orchestrate safe rollback where supported.

Liam O'Connor: Security review: ensure audit events for migration actions include actor, plan-id, justification string, and md5 of previous key metadata. Also require manager approval for high-sensitivity clusters.

Claire Boudreaux: Docs: playbook, preflight CLI ref, SRE runbook, customer FAQ, legal amendment template. Publishing ETA: internal docs tomorrow EOD, customer-facing in one week. Link will be posted here.

Rhea Kapoor: Action list TL;DR: Eng: finalize CLI + dry-run hooks (Samir/Liam). Ops: add dashboards & canary schedule (Liam/Ops). CS/Sales: SKUs + SOW (Jordan). Security/Legal: approval + amendment (Rhea). Docs: publish playbook (Claire).

Ops Bot: Canary result: canary-a success (0 errors). canary-b partial (1 token refresh failure resolved by increasing client retry window). Incident 1887690002 created for post-mortem.

Jordan Lee: Noted. Ill update customer advisory with canary results and the assistance contact.

Rhea Kapoor: Thanks team. Reopening thread if exec wants a blog or product announcement. Otherwise closing after docs link posted. :white_check_mark:
